You swallow the taste of blood and drive your weapon into your opponent, leaning so far into the blow that you leave yourself exposed.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Fortitude
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Damage and push are immediate; your defense Bane lasts until the start of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

You take the hurt and turn it outward. Make a melee attack. Until the start of your next turn, your defenses against physical attacks take 1 Bane.

Weak
3 physical damage.
Standard
4 physical damage; push 1 square.
Strong
6 physical damage; push 2 squares.
